## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, `mypy src`, and `pytest` pass.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog entries are updated when user-visible behavior changes.
- [ ] New fixtures are synthetic and clearly marked; no real or plausibly active credentials are present.
- [ ] Error messages and reports do not reveal complete matched values.

## Security impact

Explain effects on trust boundaries, network access, subprocesses, path handling, masking,
or report output. Write “None” only after checking each area.
